verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no built-in AI assistant inside Elasticsearch that a user can delegate tasks to. The AI-related items are adjacent or developer-facing: skills that teach external coding agents, an MCP server that external agents connect to, and inference or chat-completion APIs for building AI apps and agents. None of these is an in-product assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
